svg.text: The wind sweep at the impact speed (3 m/s into a 0.6 m trunk), before / after
cell = one run, the number = mount members broken (red: the mount came off); the strip under each grid = the trunk moved across the nose, no wind
the user's Cub, before: mount off in 17/49 winds, 11/19 offsets
the user's Cub, after: mount off in 0/49 winds, 0/19 offsets
Jodel, before: mount off in 0/49 winds, 2/19 offsets
Jodel, after: mount off in 0/49 winds, 0/19 offsets
metal Cessna, before: mount off in 4/49 winds, 8/19 offsets
metal Cessna, after: mount off in 0/49 winds, 0/19 offsets
